title: Crevasse Feature
description:
Properties:
• description ({ identifier })
• max_length (int)
• max_width (int)
• min_footprint (int)

identifier.title: Identifier
identifier.description: The name of this feature in the form 'namespace_name:feature_name'. 'feature_name' must match the filename.

max_length.title: Max Length
max_length.description: Maximum end-to-end length of the crevasse, in blocks.

max_width.title: Max Width
max_width.description: Maximum width of the crevasse cross-section, in blocks.

min_footprint.title: Min Footprint
min_footprint.description: Minimum connected horizontal footprint required before carving begins, in blocks.
